description: Represents an arc on a unit sphere in spherical coordinates using physics convention.  This arc is formed by a spherical reference point and then projected from that start point along the unit circle for the length of the arc in radians.

azimuth.description: Azimuthal angle in radians (0 to 2*pi).  Represents the longitudinal position around the sphere.

arcLength.description: The arc length in radians (-2*pi to 2*pi.

orient.description: The rotated orientation about the vector from the sphere's origin through the start point in radians (-pi to pi.

polar.description: Polar angle (colatitude/zenith angle) in radians (0 to pi), measured from the positive z-axis following ISO 80000-2:2019 physics convention. 0 is the north pole (+z axis), pi/2 is the equator (xy-plane), and pi is the south pole (-z axis).
